_readme: White Friday end-card fields. 'verified' must be set to true ONLY after checking a dated, current official Privilee source (campaign post, offer page, or checkout screenshot supplied by Amr). Until then renders are named *_review.mp4 and carry a small REVIEW badge. Never add expiry, savings %, promo codes or instalments that are not in the verified source.

verification.source: Amr Medhat confirmed the price on 23 Nov 2026 and supplied Privilee's official White Friday Edit post (brand/white_friday_post_2026.jpg): 'The White Friday Edit · 3 MONTHS · AED 1,899'.
notes: Earlier third-party deal roundups quoting AED 1,599 are superseded by the official post and Amr's confirmation.
Offer is UAE-only: White Friday Edit memberships exclude cross-country access (Privilee FAQ).

Privilee FAQ read directly on 24 Nov 2026 (saved: references/privilee_faq_2026-11-24.html): 'Your membership can now be used in the UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Singapore and Hong Kong.' and 'Limited-time campaign memberships, including the ... White Friday Edit ... do not include cross-country access.'

27 Nov 2026: qualifier reworded per Privilee FAQ: 'Limited-time campaign memberships and Guest passes can only be used in the country where they were purchased.' AED 1,899 is the UAE price; availability/pricing of the White Friday Edit in other countries not verified.

27 Nov 2026: read each country's official page: UAE AED 1,899 (valid in the UAE only); Qatar QAR 1,799 (Qatar only; URL redirects to the-white-friday-edit-signature); Bahrain BHD 190 (Bahrain only); Oman OMR 190 (Oman only); privilee.sg/the-white-friday-edit returns 404; no Hong Kong site linked. UAE page excludes Beach Rotana Abu Dhabi, Altitude The Gym, Veo, CRANK, 1Rebel and the Grand Hyatt / LEGOLAND / Wild Wadi waterparks.
